name: @forwardimpact/libwatchdog
description: Guardrail engine for agent teams — count repository activity over a window, compare it against thresholds, and engage an operator latch when the activity breaches them.
author: D. Olsson <hi@senzilla.io>

jobs.goal: Stand Up and Operate an Agent Team
jobs.trigger: An agent event chain creates artifacts faster than a human can read them, and no deterministic brake bounds the volume.
jobs.bigHire: bound an agent team's output volume with a deterministic brake that a human clears.
jobs.littleHire: count one activity signal over a window and engage a latch when it crosses a threshold.
jobs.competesWith: a prose recursion guard inside an agent task; a spend cap on the LLM platform; a human who notices the sprawl
